name: C-9979 landing craft
description: The C-9979 landing craft, also known as the Trade Federation landing ship or the Separatist landing craft, was a large landing craft built by Haor Chall Engineering for the Trade Federation's military forces, and later for the Confederacy of Independent Systems. When the Trade Federation began planning to create its military forces, Haor Chall Engineering produced a design for a landing craft that would carry troops and ground vehicles from warships down to planets.

data.name: C-9979 landing craft
complement: Armored Assault Tanks (114: 24 per fore wing, 33 per aft wing)
Multi-Troop Transports or Multi-Utility Transports (11: 3 per fore wing, 3 in staging area, 2 in landing pedestal)
CIS mobile command center (1) and Sheathipede-class transport shuttle(1)
